claims: Xcode Organizer reported WellSpent 0.2.0 (10) uploaded successfully, and App Store Connect subsequently showed build 10 processing complete and Ready to Submit.
App Store version 0.2.0 was changed from build 9 to exact build 10, and the saved build table showed 0.2.0 (10) with the processed phone and Apple Watch assets.

The English release notes and App Review instructions were updated for build 10, including the refreshed first-run and New Project screens, emoji-keyboard behavior, transient Watch confirmation tile and no-account review flow.
Six existing iPhone screenshots remained attached, manual release remained selected, automatic release remained unselected and the existing rating was not reset.
The owner confirmed the final App Store actions, and App Store Connect accepted one item for review with submission ID 4b863a87-074f-4314-89ef-88e7c1468072.
The authoritative submission record shows iOS App 0.2.0 (10) with status Waiting for Review and submission date Sep 7, 2026 at 8:09 PM.
limitations: Waiting for Review is not App Review approval and does not make the build publicly available.
Manual public release remains a separate owner action after approval and is not authorized by this receipt.
This release-steward observation satisfies the submission workflow but does not substitute for the independent verifier receipt required before the repository task may be marked done.

authorityReference.reference: On 2026-09-07 the owner requested building and submitting the latest app, then explicitly confirmed replacing build 9 with build 10 and submitting version 0.2.0 for App Review while retaining manual release.
